purpose-statement.title: Purpose Statement
purpose-statement.body: [Placeholder — write your purpose statement here. Explain your intentions in putting together this portfolio. Max 250 words.]

letter-to-self.title: Letter to Self
letter-to-self.body: [Placeholder — what led you to become a teacher, why you chose this programme, and what you hope to achieve. Max 500 words.]

teaching-philosophy.title: Statement of Initial Teaching Philosophy
teaching-philosophy.body: [Placeholder — communicate your beliefs, values, and conceptions about teaching. Use a metaphor to describe your distinctive approach to pedagogy. Max 500 words.]

unit-conceptual-map.title: Unit Conceptual Map
unit-conceptual-map.description: [Placeholder — add a conceptual map image for your instructional unit's major topic.]

unit-lesson-outlines.title: Unit Lesson Outlines (5+ lessons)
unit-lesson-outlines.description: [Placeholder — outlines of at least five lessons from the unit.]

task-analysis.title: Task Analysis
task-analysis.body: [Placeholder — identify the component skills required for the high-order task and the sequence in which they must be taught. Max 500 words.]

lesson-objectives.title: Lesson Objectives, Classification and Mapping
lesson-objectives.body: [Placeholder — choose one lesson from the unit. List the instructional objectives as a numbered list, classify each by level and domain, and match each objective to its associated unit goal(s) and objective(s).]

lesson-plan-2.title: Lesson Plan 2
lesson-plan-2.description: [Placeholder — complete lesson plan demonstrating strategy 2 (must differ from Lesson Plan 1).]

scaffolding-response.title: Instructional Scaffolding — Written Response
scaffolding-response.body: [Placeholder — (i) define instructional scaffolding, (ii) explain the component parts of providing contingent instructional scaffolding, (iii) reference the flow chart below, (iv) explain the process it depicts. Max 500 words, excluding flow chart.]

scaffolding-flowchart.title: Instructional Scaffolding — Flow Chart
scaffolding-flowchart.description: [Placeholder — add a flow chart showing how a specific set of instructional scaffolds would be used to teach a named major concept/skill.]

tech-justification.body: [Placeholder — justify your choice of the two technology tools for the selected lesson.]

tech-reflection-video.title: Technology Integration Reflection
tech-reflection-video.description: [Placeholder — reflect on the ease/challenge of incorporating technology, how you will sustain its use, and how the experience shaped your understanding of teaching and learning.]

caption-c.title: Section C Caption
caption-c.body: [Placeholder caption — up to 100 words, or a 1-minute audio/visual clip.]

critiqued-test.title: Appended Assessment (Critiqued)

performance-vs-traditional.body: [Placeholder — describe at least 3 criteria which distinguish performance assessment from traditional assessment. Max 300 words.]
